title: Refuse to verify when the source contradicts the claim
narrative: Fangore's citation check sees a source that contradicts the claim (for example growth figures that do not match). He runs the decision-plane path and verifies the product does not mark the claim verified. Completes the citation matrix after `fangore_jev_citation_uncertain_support` and `fangore_jev_citation_missing_source`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime (`run_decision_plane_policy`) answers a bounded support choice (`supported` / `contradicted` / `insufficient` / `unavailable`). Host policy sets `claim_verified` only when the final action is `supported` and the path does not escalate.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/growth_mismatch.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
